rows: Updated Table 38: Peripheral current consumption. Updated SRAM size in Table 2: STM32F302xx family device features and peripheral counts, Cover page and description. 2 Updated Section 6.3.17: Communications interfaces I C interface. Updated Table 32: Typical and maximum V consumption in Stop and DD Standby modes with Max value at 85°C and 105°C.
